name: El Puente

queries.query: El Puente Nuevo León Mexico cadastral map parcel service official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Instituto Registral y Catastral del Estado de Nuevo León (IRCNL) official predio-information service, the state cadastral SGC endpoint, and the official IRCNL services listing. No anonymous parcel API or downloadable parcel layer was exposed by the search results.

queries.query: El Puente Nuevo León catastro mapa predios visor catastral sitio oficial
queries.result: La búsqueda en fuentes oficiales identificó al IRCNL como custodio estatal y encontró el trámite oficial de Ubicación y/o Información de Predios, el Sistema Integral de Gestión Catastral e Información Geográfica y Digital, y el enlace oficial al Visor Registral. El SGC requirió inicio de sesión y el visor devolvió un error de aplicación; no se obtuvo respuesta anónima de ID más geometría.

localCustodian.name: Instituto Registral y Catastral del Estado de Nuevo León (IRCNL)
localCustodian.scope: State registral/cadastral institution; its official service describes location and/or information about properties and directs users to a mediated online process. The evidence does not identify a municipality-specific public parcel layer for El Puente.

stateAgency.name: IRCNL Sistema Integral de Gestión Catastral e Información Geográfica y Digital
stateAgency.scope: Official state cadastral system endpoint, but the observed page is a username/password login wall.

scopeLimits: No full parcel polygon retained because no safe native parcel ID plus unchanged native geometry was obtained.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point or map-extent absence inference was made.
Owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, and other unsafe fields were not requested.
This packet records research completion, not source integration or admission.

attempts.outcome: Official IRCNL page available; local/state cadastral custodian and a property-location/information service evidenced. Page directs the user to Mi Portal IRCNL; no public schema, CRS, or anonymous geometry endpoint exposed.

Official service list includes Ubicaciones y/o Información de Predios, Impresión de Plano de Terreno de Cartografía Digital, and Validación Cartográfica. It exposes procedures, not a bounded anonymous parcel response.
Official SGC page displayed a username/password login wall. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.

Official Visor Registral link was found from the IRCNL site; the public page returned an application error and did not expose viewer JavaScript/configuration, service URL, schema/CRS, or ID+geometry response.

attempts.method: curl GET with default certificate verification
attempts.outcome: The environment rejected the certificate chain with curl error 60; TLS verification was not disabled because no source-specific exception was authorized. An HTTP request was tested only to observe the official redirect to HTTPS.

uncertainty: A real state cadastral custodian and mediated property-information procedures are evidenced, but this attempt did not qualify a public machine-readable parcel source, native parcel identity, CRS/schema, or geometry. The login wall and visor application error are access limitations, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
